verdict.rationale: Swell documents a secret-key-authenticated backend API with official Node/PHP libraries, and webhooks that can subscribe to any model event. Orders are an existing model that apps can extend, and a single runtime call returns the full store schema, so an agent plausibly has the plumbing to read and act on orders. However, nothing in the pack shows order status transitions, fulfillment/shipment endpoints or returns handling, and probes found no OpenAPI spec for machine-readable API discovery. Missing for 10: documented order status/lifecycle endpoints, fulfillment/shipment APIs, returns/refunds APIs, order-specific webhook events, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
